util.description: Create a util package: helpers with no React and no server code.

model.description: Create a model package: Zod schemas, types, constants and pure functions.

server.description: Create a server package: server actions, queries, API clients and jobs.

ui.description: Create a ui package: presentational components and hooks that call no server code.

feature.description: Create a feature package: pages and components that call server actions.

platform-slot.description: Create a platform plugin slot package in packages/integrations/<platform>.
